seed_record.product_office: Workcell is situated existence: the concrete here with its resistance and availability; reachability does not grant permission, exposure does not abolish alterity.

family_grammar.whole_first: the S4 record's own movement path (#0 → #5→0) is the journey's whole; six scenes in the record's order, no epilogue text
family_grammar.scene_id: s4-m<N>-<movement-slug> (slug from the S record's own heading)
family_grammar.structure_staging: each scene stages the movement's own named terms as a glyph row over a ground disc, plus one glyph naming the movement's bound material record
family_grammar.bound_slice: one inventoried record per movement, 6 of 30; the movement-to-record mapping follows the S record's own named tasks (constitution, lens, constitution-of-return, relation, realised loop)
family_grammar.character_line: the scene character compresses the S record movement’s claim; page body carries it plus the bound record’s identity and public-identity note
